releaseNotes:
#  (2025-07-10)


### Bug Fixes

* Adjust `WasmShellEnableEmccProfiling` support (https://github.com/unoplatform/Uno.Wasm.Bootstrap/commit/0d571512341c507e69744987f09e69b83d7ebb17)
* Adjust HR for 17.12.4 and later (https://github.com/unoplatform/Uno.Wasm.Bootstrap/commit/f5e43ca05262471f23054c7243e16b005a2acfaf)
* Adjust support for linked assets (https://github.com/unoplatform/Uno.Wasm.Bootstrap/commit/8942406db5c72db345645c9b29ace8001d8f459a)
* Adjust workaround for https://github.com/unoplatform/Uno.Wasm.Bootstrap/commit/a26a28fe632b398f9792fbcc6a116df53fc335c8)
* Do not crash in case of a customized loader (https://github.com/unoplatform/Uno.Wasm.Bootstrap/commit/9c804308815e24bba76c3b502d8a9af9c560b897)
* don't prefix uno-assets path with the package folder for compatibility (https://github.com/unoplatform/Uno.Wasm.Bootstrap/commit/f694113f1513c20213e90847eb8aa16fdeefb9f7)
* Ensure explicit dependency for manifest generation (https://github.com/unoplatform/Uno.Wasm.Bootstrap/commit/7ebbcd16ea52496d3dc0a1b22cdaf216e71b22a4)
* list all assemblies (https://github.com/unoplatform/Uno.Wasm.Bootstrap/commit/13b36791695260e86490f46788723ab5b0fea48d)
* **res:** Fix invalid loading of satellite assemblies with WasmShellLoadAllSatelliteResources (https://github.com/unoplatform/Uno.Wasm.Bootstrap/commit/280d8d6cb323df73b799c1d0ba741a0c1307949d)
* Rewrite relative paths to absolute for server project dependencies (https://github.com/unoplatform/Uno.Wasm.Bootstrap/commit/67497f023ac902e368e93f936529f0b4c9a4a67b)


### Features

* Add support for WasmShellNativeFileReference (https://github.com/unoplatform/Uno.Wasm.Bootstrap/commit/cd0085d94da08fe6a10e3510d1eb42bb6cd4a5cf)
* Add support generic wasm apps (https://github.com/unoplatform/Uno.Wasm.Bootstrap/commit/50d66fde50c8270ba1e959740791b9b6d0f00695)
